parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic فَخْر (faḵr, “honour, pride”), the Arabic word itself could be an Iranian borrowing ultimately from Proto-Iranian *huHarnā́h (“splendour, glory”). Doublet of فَرّ (farr). See the Arabic root ف خ ر (f ḵ r) and Proto-Iranian *huHarnā́h (“splendour, glory”) for more detailed etymol
Reborrowed from Arabic فِرْدَوْس (firdaws), ultimately from Proto-Iranian *paridayjah, like the native پالیز (pālēz /pâliz).
